title: arduino_kit — the shape of this curriculum's manifest domain surfaces
description: The engine's manifest contract requires a `domain.config` and a `core_activity` per lab, and deliberately says nothing about what is in either. This is what is in them here, and it is this curriculum's to state. `$defs.config` is the predecessor curriculum schema's `kit_power_profile` and `visual_system`, moved rather than deleted; `$defs.core_activity` is that schema's `mode`/`circuit_status` enums and its power-presence rule, moved the same way. `schemas/manifest_domain.metaschema.v1.json` is what the engine requires of this file — that it constrains, not what it constrains. A curriculum in another subject supplies a different file with different values and never edits the engine's.

config.description: This curriculum's domain configuration: the one power system its labs may draw on, the roles generated imagery may play, and the circuit-sourcing policy.

circuit_policy.description: `composed` means CIRCUIT selects from a library of vetted, simulated circuits and never invents a topology. The closest published proxy to inventing one, verified by simulation, has a top-model pass rate of 8.15%.

circuit_library.description: The vetted circuit library, required under `composed`.

technical_map_rule.const: Technical build maps are deterministically rendered from verified circuit data; generative images are never the connection authority.

core_activity.description: What the learner does, in this curriculum's own vocabulary. `mode` is the hazard class and `domain_state` is how ready the lab's circuit data is — v4's `mode` and `circuit_status`, unchanged in content and no longer held by the engine.

domain_activity.description: What a powered lab needs this curriculum to state. `power_input` is the id of the one permitted supply the lab draws on, from this curriculum's own `kit_calibration.v1.yaml` `power.permitted_inputs`. "All available sources" is a kit-level statement and is never a lab-level answer; `FR-P3-KIT-SOURCE` additionally resolves the id and refuses one whose verification is not `verified_official`, so a lab cannot cite a supply nobody photographed.

allOf.description: v4's power-presence rule: an unpowered lab may not name a supply, and every lab that is not unpowered must name one. Losing this was how `mode` stopped meaning anything.
